about: Prompt words for every cast member's look: the one source for every image tool (tools/cast_looks.py reads it; the image gen dashboard, tools/production.py and the round scripts take their character looks from there, never from their own strings). Entries with cast_md are copied from that person's Look line in docs/game/cast.md (age from the same section) and checked against the approved portrait; node tools/facts/cast-looks.mjs fails when they disagree, and --stamp <id> records that an entry was re-checked after its cast.md line changed. Entries without cast_md are not in cast.md (reward-scene cast); this file is their home. Build lines and negatives follow art/PROMPTS.md (Cast prompt lines).
